Name: SORTIE_STARTING_POINT_ST
Description: Expedition starting points. One is picked at random among the rows whose modifier conditions fit, and gives the starting tile, the bird route and the landing tile.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on all 23 rows.

Fields.Name: Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: Not read: the start tile uses the current field map's area (m60). Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: BB part of the map tile where the spectral bird flight starts.

Fields.Name: Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: CC part of the map tile where the spectral bird flight starts.

Fields.Name: Bird Route Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the spectral bird route the party flies along at the start of the expedition (e.g. 1942363200).

Fields.Name: Required Modifier
Fields.Description: The start point can only be picked when the expedition has this modifier (retail 700-708: the start area drawn by the map pattern; 13000-13002 on the Great Hollow). 0: no condition. One start point is picked at random among those allowed.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier: 1
Fields.Description: The start point is not picked when the expedition has this modifier (retail: the Shifting Earth that covers the area, 11-15). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier: 2
Fields.Description: Second excluded modifier, as Excluded Modifier 1. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Spawn Map ID: AA
Fields.Description: Not read: the landing tile always uses area 60. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Spawn Map ID: BB
Fields.Description: BB part of the map tile where the party lands (m60_BB_CC_00).

Fields.Name: Spawn Map ID: CC
Fields.Description: CC part of the map tile where the party lands.

Fields.Name: Spawn Point Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the landing point in the spawn tile (e.g. 1042362200).
